item.title: Candace Owens lists 10 TPUSA verifiable lies and raises big questions about Charlie Kirk’s assassination story
item.description: Candace Owens has revealed ten alleged lies spread by Turning Point USA following Charlie Kirk's assassination. Owens claims TPUSA fabricated stories to portray individuals as more heroic and loyal, altering facts about Kirk, his beliefs, and the incident. She vows to continue investigating, believing she is close to uncovering the truth.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Olivia Nuzzi drops bombshell on 'affair with RFK Jr': He said 'I love you' first; wanted her to have his baby
item.description: Journalist Olivia Nuzzi returns with 'American Canto' after a year of self-exile, detailing her affair with RFK Jr without naming him. The book, as reported by NYT, reveals their intense connection, including his declarations of love and desire for a child, though the relationship apparently remained unconsummated. Nuzzi's career and engagement were impacted when the romance became public during the peak of the 2024 presidential election.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: White House press secretary calls climate change 'fallacy', social media says 'she mispronounced science'
item.description: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt claimed climate change is a fallacy, criticizing California's environmental policies as a "Green New Scam." Her remarks contradict the scientific consensus on global warming. The article also briefly mentions the release of Jeffrey Epstein's emails and social media reactions to climate change denial.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Top 10 most followed Twitch streamers in 2025
item.description: Twitch continues its reign as the top live streaming destination. Millions tune in daily to watch creators like Kai Cenat, Ibai Llanos, and Ninja. These streamers entertain with gaming, challenges, and engaging content. The platform showcases both established stars and emerging talents, building strong communities. Pokimane leads as the most followed female streamer, highlighting the platform's broad appeal.

item.title: Inside H-1B row: How Trump’s sudden U-turns could leave America losing the talent war to foreigners
item.description: President Trump's comments on the U.S. lacking certain talents have intensified the debate over H1-B visas. While his administration tightens rules, critics argue the program imports cheaper labor, while supporters, like Elon Musk, emphasize its role in innovation and competitiveness, highlighting the need for skilled foreign workers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'You don't own the country': Indian man in Canada gets $615 ticket for driving while 'watching a video', calls it 'racist'
item.description: An Indian man in Canada, ticketed for having his phone mounted on the windscreen while driving, accused the cop of racism. The man argued he wasn't watching videos, but the officer issued a $615 fine. Social media users pointed out that Ontario law prohibits drivers from viewing screens unrelated to driving and it was not at all a racist attack.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Was WhistlinDiesel arrested? YouTuber’s reported arrest sparks big buzz after tax details leak online
item.description: Popular YouTuber Cody Shane Detwiler, also known as WhistlinDiesel, faced arrest on November 13, 2025. Reports indicate tax evasion charges in Williamson County, Tennessee. A substantial bond was set. Detwiler himself confirmed the arrest via social media. This news has sparked widespread online discussion among his followers and the wider internet community.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Emiru sparks confusion by revealing an unexpected warning to stop flying alone after her TwitchCon assault
item.description: Twitch streamer Emiru has sparked fan concern after revealing she drove to Kansas due to advice against flying alone. This statement follows her disclosure of being assaulted at TwitchCon 2025, leading many to believe the travel warning is linked to her safety fears. The streamer has not elaborated, leaving viewers anxious.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Amazon delivery driver barges into British MP's house; cops say 'we can't do anything'
item.description: UK MP James McMurdock shared alarming doorcam footage of an Amazon delivery driver forcing his way into his home. Police reportedly dismissed the incident as a civil matter, stating they could not intervene. McMurdock expressed concern over the legal loophole and the potential risks to families. He said he confronted the man as he was at the right place, but he would raise the issue in Parliament.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump claims Bill Clinton ‘spent his life’ on Epstein Island; says he will order DOJ and FBI probe
item.description: President Trump announced he will ask the DOJ to investigate figures linked to Jeffrey Epstein, including Bill Clinton and Larry Summers, after Democrats released emails involving Epstein and Trump. Trump claims Democrats are using the "Epstein Hoax" to distract from other issues, while Epstein's emails suggest Trump knew about underage girls.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: King Charles' birthday: Why his divorce from Princess Diana still dominates royal history
item.description: King Charles's divorce from Princess Diana profoundly impacted the monarchy, exposing it to unprecedented public scrutiny and altering scandal management. Diana's candid interviews and tragic death cemented her 'people's princess' image, forever changing the royal family's relationship with the public and media. These lasting effects continue to shape royal dynamics today.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan turns 43: A look inside the life of the world’s most active royal
item.description: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum, known as Fazza, celebrates his 43rd birthday as a modern royal admired for his adventurous spirit, social media presence, and down-to-earth personality. From skydiving and horse riding to poetry and philanthropy, he combines family life, luxury, creativity, and public service, inspiring millions while embodying the energy, culture, and ambition of contemporary Dubai.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JD Vance grilled for joking about Joe Biden dying, saying former president could 'croak any minute': 'Has he seen his boss?'
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance faced criticism for a joke about President Joe Biden's potential death during a Fox News interview. Democrats condemned the remark as insensitive and irresponsible, accusing Vance of deflecting from questions about Donald Trump's health. The exchange occurred while discussing Trump's well-being and the possibility of a presidential succession.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JD Vance on foreign workers amid H-1B row: 'We don't need low-wage servants'
item.description: As Vance said US should avoid relying on low-wage workers and instead focus on using technology to empower the blue-collar workers, he struck a different chord with the President. Because the president said America lacks certain types of talent and cited the example of the battery plant in Georgia that was raided.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: How was the first full-colour photograph of Earth captured by NASA
item.description: NASA's 1967 ATS-3 satellite captured Earth's first true-colour image, revolutionizing weather forecasting and planetary understanding. This breakthrough, using a novel scanning camera, allowed scientists to distinguish cloud layers and storm patterns with unprecedented clarity. The vivid global portrait fostered environmental awareness, bridging science and public consciousness, and laid the foundation for modern satellite imaging.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: 'My wife is being attacked': Influencer says he has to leave house because of 'frivolous' lawsuit of Kash Patel's girlfriend
item.description: Elijah Schaffer claims he is being doxxed and attacked, forcing him to leave his home due to a defamation lawsuit filed by Alexis Wilkins, Kash Patel's girlfriend. Wilkinshas sued Schaffer and others for $5 million each, accusing them of spreading rumors she works for Mossad and 'honeytrapped' FBI Director Patel.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Fan’ Prince William poses with football legend Neil Warnock after helping a local club secure a new road
item.description: Prince William's intervention helped Mousehole AFC secure a long-awaited access road, connecting the club with businesses and experts to overcome years of frustration. This royal push facilitated a community partnership that built a new road, significantly accelerating the project and bringing a tangible achievement to the club and its supporters.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Axial Seamount may erupt by 2026: Uncovering the hidden dangers of Oregon’s most active underwater volcano
item.description: Oregon's Axial Seamount, a highly active underwater volcano, is closely monitored for potential eruptions by mid-to-late 2026. Scientists track seafloor inflation and seismic activity, noting that eruptions follow periods of magma accumulation and stress. While predictions are based on historical patterns, new physics-based models are being tested to improve forecasting accuracy.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk
